scope: Finite explicit phonetic units, not text G2P. IPA/X-SAMPA meanings never depend on language. Compound Mandarin rimes are written as IPA sequences within a whitespace-delimited unit. Native means an existing broad phonemic model path, not perfect phonetic realization. Japanese is an explicit cross-language approximation.

duration_policy.note: Reserve each native phone minimum; count an expanded canonical consonant once in min(0.06*sum(canonical consonant length),0.35*total), bounded by all native minima. Divide consonant excess between canonical units by length; palatal /j/ helpers retain only their native minimum. Divide vowel remainder by length. Kana groups reserve one ordinary mora for the C/V split and each extra っ/ー mora for its own consonant/nucleus. Manual native-phone weights remain exact shares and override automatic timing.

markers.note: A stress marker starts a new syllable after existing phones unless a dot already started one; it applies through that syllable. Stress defaults to 0 for English. A suffix length marker is part of a supported unit, never stripped.

japanese_kana.scope: Finite kana reading helper, not Japanese text G2P. No kanji, word accent, particle reading, or automatic vowel devoicing. Matching kana provenance permits conservative moraic-nasal place assimilation before selected consonants within the same written word; canonical IPA remains unchanged and realized targets are separately traced. Other nasal allophones remain approximate. Explicit ー is honored. Optional common-long-vowel rules are an author-selected orthographic heuristic, not a lexical dictionary.
japanese_kana.source: Curated standard kana correspondences; special-mora distinctions cross-checked against NINJAL CSJ labeling and TUFS pronunciation materials.
